note: Influence and approval are gameplay starting values for 1 January 2000 (One Israel-led coalition under Ehud Barak), not measured data. Influence reflects institutional weight: a conscript army and security services with a large role in policy, the Histadrut labour federation, a religious establishment with authority over personal status law, and a competitive press.
